data.name: Primary Efficacy Objective
data.text: To evaluate if concomitant administration of mirikizumab and tirzepatide at the MTD (up to 15 mg) is superior to mirikizumab and placebo in simultaneously achieving clinical remission and weight reduction

data.name: Key Secondary Gastroenterologic Outcomes Objective
data.text: To evaluate the effect of treatment with concomitant administration of mirikizumab and tirzepatide at the MTD (up to 15 mg) versus mirikizumab and placebo as measured by gastroenterologic outcomes

data.name: Additional Secondary Gastroenterologic and Patient-Reported Outcomes Objective
data.text: To evaluate the effect of treatment with concomitant administration of mirikizumab and tirzepatide at the MTD (up to 15 mg) versus mirikizumab and placebo as measured by gastroenterologic and patient-reported outcomes
